Since the Lipschitz constant $L$ is defined as the bound on the gradient magnitude ($L = sup ||f'(x)||$), the existence of a local Lipschitz bound $L_{cell}$ for each cell implies that the function satisfies the Lipschitz condition $||f(x) - f(y)|| <= L_{cell} ||x - y||$ for all points within that cell.
